overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long FIX Daily ETF (FIXX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Comfort Systems USA, Inc. (NYSE: FIX) stock, less fees and expenses FIXX was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
